en.headline: Kitchee open AFC Champions League Two campaign at Mong Kok
en.dek: The Hong Kong champions host South Korea’s Gangwon FC at 8.15pm in Group H, with Kuching City and Phnom Penh Crown the other sides in the pool.
body: Kitchee begin their 2026-27 AFC Champions League Two group campaign on Thursday night, hosting South Korean club Gangwon FC at Mong Kok Stadium with kick-off at 8.15pm.

The match is the first fixture in Group H, which also includes Malaysia’s Kuching City and Cambodia’s Phnom Penh Crown. Those two sides meet in Phnom Penh on the same matchday. Kitchee’s remaining home group games at Mong Kok Stadium are scheduled against Phnom Penh Crown on 5 November and Kuching City on 3 December.

Gangwon reached the knockout rounds of last season’s AFC Champions League Elite before dropping into this season’s second-tier continental competition. Kitchee enter the group as Hong Kong Premier League title holders.

Tai Po, Hong Kong’s other representative in the competition, play Adelaide United away on the same matchday. Supporters heading to Mong Kok were advised to check the Hong Kong Football Association and club channels for the latest admission details.

zh.headline: 傑志亞冠二級聯賽首戰今晚旺角迎戰江原FC
zh.dek: 港超冠軍晚上8時15分在旺角大球場揭開H組戰幕，同組還有古晉城及金邊皇冠。
body: 傑志周四晚上展開2026至27年度亞洲冠軍聯賽二級聯賽小組賽，晚上8時15分在旺角大球場主場迎戰南韓球會江原FC。
這是H組首場賽事，同組另外兩隊為馬來西亞古晉城及柬埔寨金邊皇冠，兩隊同日在金邊交鋒。傑志其餘兩場主場小組賽亦安排在旺角大球場，分別於11月5日對金邊皇冠，以及12月3日對古晉城。
江原上季打入亞冠精英聯賽淘汰賽，本季改戰二級賽事。傑志則以香港超級聯賽冠軍身分出戰。
另一支港隊大埔同日作客澳洲阿德萊德聯。前往旺角的球迷應留意香港足球總會及球會公布的最新入場安排。
